query: Build the monthly SEO report and summarize what changed in search last month.
expected_behavior: Works from the Facilitron Search Console (GSC) report, pointing non-technical users to the hosted GSC Analyzer at seo.facilitron.work and engineers to the CLI rather than fabricating metrics
Interprets the GSC markdown into a shareable SEO summary plus a leadership translation and slide inputs
Proposes concrete follow-up tasks off the data
Optionally pulls GA4 context via the analytics MCP when useful

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target surface, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free: interprets and repackages the report, does not branch or commit
